body:
Maadi Law: Google Ads conversion tracking fix
@Ads Team﻿ ﻿@Muhammad Hashir Faiz﻿ ﻿@Ahmed Memon﻿ ﻿ p﻿Please work on this together.

Google Ads is producing leads, but Google can't see them. Google strategy decisions are on hold until this is fixed, so treat it as a priority.

What the GHL data shows (contacts added Oct 14 to Oct 28):
- 12 calls came in on the Google Ads tracking line. None of these contacts has a Google click ID (gclid, gbraid or wbraid), so Google has nothing to match them to a click. This is why the conversion action gets pings but nothing is attributed to campaigns.
- 2 form fills from the car-accident landing page (source "ppc:car-accident-lawyer") came in through a GHL workflow with no click ID and no UTMs.
- 5 of the 12 Google Ads line callers first came in through Meta instant forms. Either they also saw a Google ad, or the Google Ads number is reaching Meta leads through follow-up texts, callbacks or auto-replies. If it's the second, Meta leads are being counted as Google.

What needs to happen:

Ads Team (owner)
- Confirm auto-tagging is on in the Google Ads account.
- Confirm which conversion actions are primary and how each one is fed (GHL upload, website tag or call reporting).
- Run the test below and post the results in this item.

Hashir (Web)
- On every Google Ads landing page, capture gclid, gbraid, wbraid and UTMs from the URL into hidden form fields, and store them in a first-party cookie so they survive page navigation.
- Install the GHL number pool script on the landing pages once Ahmed sets it up, so Google Ads visitors see a pool number instead of the static Google Ads line.

Ahmed (GHL)
- Fix the landing page form workflow so gclid, gbraid, wbraid and UTMs are written to the contact.
- Set up a GHL number pool for Google Ads traffic so each call carries the visitor's click ID.
- Make sure the conversion sent to Google Ads includes the gclid.
- Check which number Meta lead follow-ups, missed-call texts and callbacks go out from. If it's the Google Ads line, move them off it.

Test before closing this item:
1. Click a Google ad and submit the landing page form. Confirm the gclid lands on the GHL contact.
2. Click a Google ad and call the number on the page. Confirm the call contact carries the gclid.
3. Confirm both show as attributed conversions in Google Ads within 24 to 48 hours. @Ads Team @Ahmed Memon @Muhammad Hashir Faiz﻿﻿
